title: Tool declaration
description: A tool as the harness knows it: the model-visible definition plus facts the harness owns.

sideEffects.description: Set by the harness author, never taken from the tool annotations. none: pure computation. read: reads state, changes nothing. write: changes state in a way that can be undone. irreversible: cannot be undone (delete, send, pay, publish).

external.description: True if the tool reaches outside the project environment (network, third parties). Default false.

annotations.description: Untrusted hints from the tool author (for example MCP annotations). Never used for permission decisions.
